questions.question: What is Planck’s constant denoted by?
What phenomenon does the photoelectric effect refer to?

answers.a: Emission of electrons from a metal when it is heated
answers.b: Emission of photons from a radioactive substance
answers.c: Emission of electrons from a metal when light is shone on it
answers.d: Absorption of heat by a conductor

questions.question: What is the stopping potential in a photoelectric experiment?

answers.a: The potential difference needed to accelerate electrons
answers.b: The voltage required to stop the most energetic photoelectrons
answers.c: The potential that causes a metal to emit electrons
answers.d: The current applied to the metal
